title: I built a trading education prototype — looking for brutally honest feedback
author: Effective-Barber8084
selftext:
Hey everyone!



I’m a student building a trading education app prototype called “The Predictor”.



It is NOT a real-money trading app and it does NOT provide guaranteed predictions or financial advice. The prototype uses simulated/sample data and is mainly focused on helping beginners learn about:



• Market analysis

• Risk management

• Paper trading

• AI-assisted learning

• Trade reviews and mistakes

• Progress/XP-based learning



I’m looking for completely honest feedback from traders and people interested in AI/trading.



Prototype:

[https://www.figma.com/make/7dzeL63jkmbftBLrdlvS2g/Educational-Fintech-App-Prototype?code-node-id=0-6&p=f&t=PFWDoyWBFf9hFjW5-0&fullscreen=1](https://www.figma.com/make/7dzeL63jkmbftBLrdlvS2g/Educational-Fintech-App-Prototype?code-node-id=0-6&p=f&t=PFWDoyWBFf9hFjW5-0&fullscreen=1)

Feedback form:

[https://forms.gle/PL4zkNqAb6zpoE5q7](https://forms.gle/PL4zkNqAb6zpoE5q7)



You don't need to sign up or give any personal information.



Please be brutally honest — I’m especially interested in what feels useful, confusing, unnecessary, or missing.



Thanks!
